resources.string: OpenRCT2 Pocket keeps your parks and settings in %1$s and reads your RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files from storage, so it needs access to your files.\n\nOn the next screen, turn on access for OpenRCT2 Pocket, then press Back.

OpenRCT2 Pocket runs on the files from your own copy of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 (sold on Steam and GOG). None are included.

Copy the Data, ObjData and Scenarios folders from your RCT2 install into:
%1$s

so that Data/g1.dat is inside it. These folders were checked:%2$s
